title: Greenberg's Conjecture on Vanishing of Iwasawa Invariants of Totally Real Fields
exact_target: In a totally real field's cyclotomic tower, do the p-parts of the ideal class groups remain bounded in size?

sources.citation: Mohamed Mahmoud Chems-Eddin et al., "Greenberg's conjecture and Iwasawa module of Real biquadratic fields I," arXiv:2503.15727 (2025); companion published version in J. Number Theory (2025).
